description: Repository questions for codebase-agent's own source tree. expected_files are repository-relative POSIX paths; a match is any candidate path that equals or ends with an expected path.

questions.question: Where is the repository root sandbox enforced and what happens when a path escapes it?
Which module builds the FAISS vector index and how are embeddings normalized before search?
How does the agent avoid answering a question without any repository evidence?
What fields does the structured answer schema require and how is the confidence bounded?
How are source files chunked for retrieval and what metadata does each chunk carry?
Where are the OpenAI-compatible base_url and model read from, and which provider is the default?
How is the conversation memory trimmed between turns?
Which tools are exposed to the model and what kinds of files does read_file refuse?
How can the tests run the agent loop without calling a real paid API?
Where is the chat model constructed and which timeout and retry settings are applied?
